name: Sei to Shi no Ana
source:
Satou Hiromu (the protagonist) worked at a ski resort.
That's when had a terrifying dream vision of a mysterious cave...

And once he is awake, the stuff of dreams becomes reality...

Footsteps of the dead echo in darkness... 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE066083.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一家滑雪场工作。
就在这里，他梦见了一座神秘洞穴，那景象恐怖至极……

然而，当他从梦中醒来，梦境里的一切竟开始化为现实……

死者的脚步声，在黑暗中回荡……

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE066083.html]DLsite[/url]]
